text: かいパンやろうは　もう　みあきたって？

structure.jp: かいパンやろうは　もう　みあきたって？
structure.en: you're saying you're already sick of seeing guys in swim trunks?

patterns.name: 〜と (quoting)
patterns.explanation: って is the casual form of と, which wraps up what someone said. With a rising voice it means 'are you saying...?'. みあきたって？ = 'you're saying you're sick of seeing them?'.
